entities.name: Phyrexian War Beast
entities.description: Whale-like artificial war machines created by Phyrexia, found by Soldevi diggers.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: Source of the artifact war beasts.

entities.name: Soldev
entities.description: City whose diggers found the war beasts.

entities.name: Koilos
entities.description: Area where war beasts were excavated.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: War during which agents of Phyrexia created the war beasts.

entities.name: Arcum Dagsson
entities.description: Inspired by the war beasts to create the Soldevi Steam Beasts.

entities.name: Soldevi Adnates
entities.description: Group that took the war beasts from the vaults and repaired them.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: Planeswalker who, possessed by Mairsil, activated the war beasts and later crushed six of them.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Archmage whose blood was used to activate the war beasts.

entities.name: Fall of Soldev
entities.description: Destruction of Soldev by the activated war beasts.

entities.name: Fall of the School of the Unseen

entities.name: Gerda Äagesdotter
entities.description: Defender who helped destroy two war beasts.

entities.name: Lat-Nam
entities.description: Place where Jaya crushed the remaining war beasts.

events.summary: Jaya, possessed by Mairsil, brought Jodah to the vaults, cut his throat and used his blood to activate the war beasts.
events.quote: she cut his throat and used his blood

events.summary: The war beasts rose and began the Fall of Soldev.
The war beasts caused the Fall of the School of the Unseen; defenders destroyed two of eight.
events.quote: caused the Fall of the School of the Unseen

events.summary: Jaya, now a sparked planeswalker, crushed the remaining six war beasts.
events.quote: picked the remaining six war beasts up into the air and crushed them
